## Checklist

- [ ] Build is green (`./gradlew build`; for Python: `ruff check`, `mypy`, `pytest`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed behavior
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/API.md`, `docs/OPERATIONS.md`, `.env.example`, `docs/DECISIONS.md`) where relevant
- [ ] No new dependency, or the reason is explained below
- [ ] No secrets, datasets, or build output committed
- [ ] No dashes as punctuation and no emojis; commit message is a single line `type(scope): summary`
